$comment: Vendored from the Gabriel Design System (design/core/CORE.md).
name: Gabriel Design System

core.$comment: Shared by every app. Every layer must include every core token (scripts/check_tokens.py enforces it).

color.name: page
color.usage: Screen background inside the mint frame.

color.name: surface
color.usage: Header, tab bar, fields, cards, sheets.

color.name: ink
color.usage: Text, icons, secondary buttons, the recorder panel in light.

color.name: muted
color.usage: Meta text, captions, row values. 5.9:1 on page in light.

color.name: line
color.usage: Hairlines under rows, field and chip borders. Never for text.

color.name: mint
color.usage: The one primary action per screen, the title highlighter, the active tab pill, progress chips, the 4dp frame. Text on it is ink.

color.name: on-mint
color.usage: Small text on a mint fill (chips). 9:1 on mint.

color.name: coral
color.usage: Stop button fill and the recording dot. Text and icons on it use on-coral.

color.name: coral-text
color.usage: Alert text, destructive button text and outline, on page, surface or coral-soft.

color.name: coral-soft
color.usage: Tint behind coral-text chips (Interrupted, Needs attention) so 12px text passes 4.5:1.

spacing.name: space-2
spacing.usage: Inside a row, between label and value; under a caption.

spacing.name: space-3
spacing.usage: Between stacked lines in one item; caption to its rows.

spacing.name: space-4
spacing.usage: Row vertical padding; row inset inside a group; item vertical padding.

spacing.name: space-6
spacing.usage: Page gutter on phones; between items in a group.

spacing.name: space-8
spacing.usage: Page top under the header; page gutter on screens 600dp and wider.

spacing.name: space-10
spacing.usage: Above a section caption. The only gap between sections.

spacing.name: space-12
spacing.usage: Minimum control height and touch target.

spacing.name: space-16
spacing.usage: Tab bar and large Record button height.

radius.name: radius-l
radius.usage: Pills: filter chips, tab pill, the app switch, sheet top corners.

size.name: frame
size.usage: The mint border around every screen.

motion.name: motion-standard
motion.usage: Presses, colour changes, tab crossfades, small fades.

motion.name: motion-emphasised
motion.usage: Screens opening and closing, content rising in, sheets, the frame fading back to mint.
